purpose: Machine-readable bridge from every active shorthand key through the accepted 183-unit corpus; OLP-0183 adds no shorthand calls and contributes one foundational model-theory title term.

rendering_policy.articles: Suppress all English a/an output while preserving requested initial capitalization.
rendering_policy.contextual_repair: Introduce canon-linked case/agreement variants or replace a shorthand call with explicit Interslavic text without changing protected mathematical TeX topology.
rendering_policy.default_slots: s/p/S/P hold only nominative/default lemma surfaces inherited from the upstream interface.
rendering_policy.final_gate: No complete public reader may be claimed until contextual token morphology debt is zero and the cumulative source/build/render validators pass.

successor_note: This successor records OLP-0183 in the accepted-target aggregate. Its chapter wrapper contains no shorthand calls, so token counts and forms remain unchanged while accepted coverage advances by one unit.
